Hi Samir 


Great to meet you and Olivia on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on what we discussed: 

Recap
- Goal: provide a RAG-enabled assistant for internal knowledge (sales + product docs, support KB) with strong grounding and sub-second median latency for short queries.
- Success metrics you care about: grounding precision (low hallucination), MRR/P@1 on retrieval tasks, and end-to-end 95th pct latency under 600ms for short queries.

Recommended initial setup (what we'll run in PoC)
- Retrieval: sparse + vector hybrid (BM25 fallback) with embeddings indexed in Faiss (HNSW).
- Embedding model: redwood-embed-768 (recommended for ACME doc types).
- Candidate retrieval: top_k = 50 (recall-focused), re-rank down to top_k = 5 for generation.
- Reranker: cross-encoder-reranker-v1 for final ranking (good precision/grounding improvements).
- Generator: redwood-llama-2-13b-q4 as primary; fallback to redwood-llama-2-7b for low-cost queries.

Eval & artifacts we suggested we run
- Shared prompt set you mentioned (please attach your canonical prompts / sample queries).
- Benchmarks: MRR@5, P@1, grounding precision (human-labeled sample), hallucination-rate on knowledge checks.
- We'll run both document-chunk sizes: 500 tokens (no overlap) and 250 tokens with 50-token overlap to compare grounding.

Next steps
1) Please send the sample queries/prompt set you referenced (or attach a CSV).
2) We'll schedule a 30-min sync next week to align on success thresholds and timeline.
3) With your OK we'll spin up a short PoC (2 weeks) using your sample prompts and ~10k doc corpus.

I've attached a short evaluation plan draft and a prompt-set template to make it easy.

Thanks

Samir / Marissa 


Indexing / chunks
- Chunk size: test 500-token chunks (single doc chunks) and 250-token chunks with 50-token overlap. Smaller chunks improve P@1; overlapping reduces context loss at boundaries but increases index size.
- Embedding model: redwood-embed-768 (float16); store in Faiss HNSW index for fast ANN.

Retrieval flow
- Candidate retrieval: top_k = 50 via ANN; also keep BM25 sparse results as a fallback for exact match queries.
- Rerank: cross-encoder-reranker-v1 run in batch (batch size tuned to p95 latency target). Use score threshold to trim to top 5.

Reranker vs Bi-encoder tradeoffs
- Bi-encoder (cheap) for low-latency, but lower precision. We'll baseline with bi-encoder + simple MLP rerank to measure cost. If grounding precision is insufficient, promote cross-encoder reranker.

Metrics & eval harness
- Automatic metrics: MRR@5, P@1, recall@5.
- Grounding metrics: grounding_precision (fraction of generator answers that cite at least one relevant document), hallucination_rate (human adjudicated on sample of 200 queries).
- Latency: median and p95 end-to-end (tokenization + retrieval + rerank + generation). Set targets: median < 350ms, p95 < 600ms for short queries.

Operational notes
- Chunking policy: canonical tokenizer with 100-token overlap for one of the config variants; store chunk metadata (doc_id, offset) for deterministic grounding links.
- Caching: KV cache for repeated prompts and prefix caching for common queries.

I'll instrument the PoC harness to export these metrics to the shared Drive doc and tie to the HubSpot deal ID.
